species.name: bulbasaur
species.description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

species.name: ivysaur
species.description: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

species.name: venusaur
species.description: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

species.name: charmander
species.description: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

species.name: charmeleon
species.description: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.

species.name: charizard
species.description: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.

species.name: squirtle
species.description: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

species.name: wartortle
species.description: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

species.name: blastoise
species.description: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.

species.name: caterpie
species.description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

species.name: metapod
species.description: This Pokémon is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

species.name: butterfree
species.description: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

species.name: weedle
species.description: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.

species.name: kakuna
species.description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

species.name: beedrill
species.description: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

species.name: pidgey
species.description: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

species.name: pidgeotto
species.description: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

species.name: pidgeot
species.description: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.

species.name: rattata
species.description: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

species.name: raticate
species.description: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

species.name: spearow
species.description: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

species.name: fearow
species.description: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

species.name: ekans
species.description: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.

species.name: arbok
species.description: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

species.name: pikachu
species.description: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

species.name: raichu
species.description: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.

species.name: sandshrew
species.description: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

species.name: sandslash
species.description: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

species.name: nidoran-f
species.description: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

species.name: nidorina
species.description: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

species.name: nidoqueen
species.description: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

species.name: nidoran-m
species.description: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.

species.name: nidorino
species.description: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

species.name: nidoking
species.description: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.

species.name: clefairy
species.description: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

species.name: clefable
species.description: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

species.name: vulpix
species.description: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

species.name: ninetales
species.description: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.

species.name: jigglypuff
species.description: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

species.name: wigglytuff
species.description: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

species.name: zubat
species.description: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

species.name: golbat
species.description: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

species.name: oddish
species.description: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

species.name: gloom
species.description: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

species.name: vileplume
species.description: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

species.name: paras
species.description: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

species.name: parasect
species.description: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

species.name: venonat
species.description: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

species.name: venomoth
species.description: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

species.name: diglett
species.description: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

species.name: dugtrio
species.description: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

species.name: meowth
species.description: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

species.name: persian
species.description: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

species.name: psyduck
species.description: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily Pokémon will use psychokinetic powers.

species.name: golduck
species.description: Often seen swimming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.

species.name: mankey
species.description: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.

species.name: primeape
species.description: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.

species.name: growlithe
species.description: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

species.name: arcanine
species.description: A Pokémon that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

species.name: poliwag
species.description: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.

species.name: poliwhirl
species.description: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

species.name: poliwrath
species.description: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

species.name: abra
species.description: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.

species.name: kadabra
species.description: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.

species.name: alakazam
species.description: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.

species.name: machop
species.description: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

species.name: machoke
species.description: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

species.name: machamp
species.description: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.

species.name: bellsprout
species.description: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

species.name: weepinbell
species.description: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.

species.name: victreebel
species.description: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

species.name: tentacool
species.description: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.

species.name: tentacruel
species.description: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

species.name: geodude
species.description: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

species.name: graveler
species.description: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

species.name: golem
species.description: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

species.name: ponyta
species.description: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.

species.name: rapidash
species.description: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

species.name: slowpoke
species.description: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

species.name: slowbro
species.description: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.

species.name: magnemite
species.description: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.

species.name: magneton
species.description: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

species.name: farfetchd
species.description: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.

species.name: doduo
species.description: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

species.name: dodrio
species.description: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

species.name: seel
species.description: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

species.name: dewgong
species.description: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

species.name: grimer
species.description: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

species.name: muk
species.description: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

species.name: shellder
species.description: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

species.name: cloyster
species.description: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.

species.name: gastly
species.description: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

species.name: haunter
species.description: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

species.name: gengar
species.description: Under a full moon, this Pokémon likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

species.name: onix
species.description: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.

species.name: drowzee
species.description: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

species.name: hypno
species.description: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.

species.name: krabby
species.description: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

species.name: kingler
species.description: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

species.name: voltorb
species.description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.

species.name: electrode
species.description: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

species.name: exeggcute
species.description: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

species.name: exeggutor
species.description: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.

species.name: cubone
species.description: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokémon's real face.

species.name: marowak
species.description: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

species.name: hitmonlee
species.description: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

species.name: hitmonchan
species.description: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.

species.name: lickitung
species.description: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.

species.name: koffing
species.description: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

species.name: weezing
species.description: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.

species.name: rhyhorn
species.description: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

species.name: rhydon
species.description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.

species.name: chansey
species.description: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.

species.name: tangela
species.description: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. Its vines shake as it walks.

species.name: kangaskhan
species.description: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.

species.name: horsea
species.description: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

species.name: seadra
species.description: Capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

species.name: goldeen
species.description: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.

species.name: seaking
species.description: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

species.name: staryu
species.description: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

species.name: starmie
species.description: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

species.name: mr-mime
species.description: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.

species.name: scyther
species.description: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.

species.name: jynx
species.description: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

species.name: electabuzz
species.description: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

species.name: magmar
species.description: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

species.name: pinsir
species.description: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.

species.name: tauros
species.description: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

species.name: magikarp
species.description: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

species.name: gyarados
species.description: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

species.name: lapras
species.description: A Pokémon that has been overhunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.

species.name: ditto
species.description: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

species.name: eevee
species.description: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.

species.name: vaporeon
species.description: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

species.name: jolteon
species.description: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.

species.name: flareon
species.description: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

species.name: porygon
species.description: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

species.name: omanyte
species.description: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

species.name: omastar
species.description: A prehistoric Pokémon that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.

species.name: kabuto
species.description: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.

species.name: kabutops
species.description: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

species.name: aerodactyl
species.description: A ferocious, prehistoric Pokémon that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.

species.name: snorlax
species.description: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

species.name: articuno
species.description: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

species.name: zapdos
species.description: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

species.name: moltres
species.description: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

species.name: dratini
species.description: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.

species.name: dragonair
species.description: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

species.name: dragonite
species.description: An extremely rarely seen marine Pokémon. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

species.name: mewtwo
species.description: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

species.name: mew
species.description: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

species.name: chikorita
species.description: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.

species.name: bayleef
species.description: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.

species.name: meganium
species.description: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

species.name: cyndaquil
species.description: It is timid, and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

species.name: quilava
species.description: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

species.name: typhlosion
species.description: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

species.name: totodile
species.description: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

species.name: croconaw
species.description: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

species.name: feraligatr
species.description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

species.name: sentret
species.description: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

species.name: furret
species.description: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

species.name: hoothoot
species.description: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

species.name: noctowl
species.description: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

species.name: ledyba
species.description: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.

species.name: ledian
species.description: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

species.name: spinarak
species.description: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

species.name: ariados
species.description: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.

species.name: crobat
species.description: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

species.name: chinchou
species.description: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

species.name: lanturn
species.description: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

species.name: pichu
species.description: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.

species.name: cleffa
species.description: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

species.name: igglybuff
species.description: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.

species.name: togepi
species.description: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

species.name: togetic
species.description: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

species.name: natu
species.description: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

species.name: xatu
species.description: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

species.name: mareep
species.description: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

species.name: flaaffy
species.description: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

species.name: ampharos
species.description: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

species.name: bellossom
species.description: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

species.name: marill
species.description: The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.

species.name: azumarill
species.description: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast- moving rivers.

species.name: sudowoodo
species.description: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.

species.name: politoed
species.description: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

species.name: hoppip
species.description: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.

species.name: skiploom
species.description: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

species.name: jumpluff
species.description: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.

species.name: aipom
species.description: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

species.name: sunkern
species.description: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.

species.name: sunflora
species.description: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

species.name: yanma
species.description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

species.name: wooper
species.description: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

species.name: quagsire
species.description: This carefree Pokémon has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

species.name: espeon
species.description: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

species.name: umbreon
species.description: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

species.name: murkrow
species.description: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

species.name: slowking
species.description: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

species.name: misdreavus
species.description: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

species.name: unown
species.description: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

species.name: wobbuffet
species.description: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.

species.name: girafarig
species.description: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

species.name: pineco
species.description: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

species.name: forretress
species.description: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.

species.name: dunsparce
species.description: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

species.name: gligar
species.description: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

species.name: steelix
species.description: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

species.name: snubbull
species.description: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.

species.name: granbull
species.description: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.

species.name: qwilfish
species.description: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

species.name: scizor
species.description: It swings its eye- patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.

species.name: shuckle
species.description: The BERRIES it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

species.name: heracross
species.description: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies then lifts and throws them.

species.name: sneasel
species.description: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

species.name: teddiursa
species.description: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

species.name: ursaring
species.description: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen BERRIES.

species.name: slugma
species.description: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

species.name: magcargo
species.description: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

species.name: swinub
species.description: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

species.name: piloswine
species.description: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

species.name: corsola
species.description: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.

species.name: remoraid
species.description: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

species.name: octillery
species.description: It traps enemies with its suction- cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

species.name: delibird
species.description: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

species.name: mantine
species.description: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

species.name: skarmory
species.description: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.

species.name: houndour
species.description: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

species.name: houndoom
species.description: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

species.name: kingdra
species.description: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

species.name: phanpy
species.description: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

species.name: donphan
species.description: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to knock down a house.

species.name: porygon2
species.description: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

species.name: stantler
species.description: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

species.name: smeargle
species.description: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

species.name: tyrogue
species.description: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

species.name: hitmontop
species.description: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dance-like kicks, you may get drilled hard.

species.name: smoochum
species.description: Its lips are the most sensitive parts on its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

species.name: elekid
species.description: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.

species.name: magby
species.description: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.

species.name: miltank
species.description: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

species.name: blissey
species.description: Anyone who takes even one bite of BLISSEY's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

species.name: raikou
species.description: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

species.name: entei
species.description: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

species.name: suicune
species.description: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

species.name: larvitar
species.description: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

species.name: pupitar
species.description: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.

species.name: tyranitar
species.description: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

species.name: lugia
species.description: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

species.name: ho-oh
species.description: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven- colored wings.

species.name: celebi
species.description: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

species.name: treecko
species.description: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This Pokémon attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.

species.name: grovyle
species.description: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This Pokémon is a master at climbing trees in jungles.

species.name: sceptile
species.description: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE’s body are very sharp edged. This Pokémon is very agile - it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.

species.name: torchic
species.description: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER, following behind with unsteady steps. This Pokémon breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees F, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.

species.name: combusken
species.description: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This Pokémon’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out ten kicks in one second.

species.name: blaziken
species.description: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this Pokémon’s wrists burn.

species.name: mudkip
species.description: The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this Pokémon can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.

species.name: marshtomp
species.description: The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This Pokémon plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.

species.name: swampert
species.description: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This Pokémon also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.

species.name: poochyena
species.description: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This Pokémon chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.

species.name: mightyena
species.description: MIGHTYENA gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This Pokémon will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.

species.name: zigzagoon
species.description: ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This Pokémon does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.

species.name: linoone
species.description: LINOONE always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This Pokémon is very challenged by gently curving roads.

species.name: wurmple
species.description: Using the spikes on its rear end, WURMPLE peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This Pokémon’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.

species.name: silcoon
species.description: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this Pokémon hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.

species.name: beautifly
species.description: BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this Pokémon, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY is sure to come looking for pollen.

species.name: cascoon
species.description: CASCOON makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This Pokémon prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.

species.name: dustox
species.description: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this Pokémon are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.

species.name: lotad
species.description: LOTAD live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this Pokémon travels on land in search of clean water.

species.name: lombre
species.description: LOMBRE is nocturnal - it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief-maker. When this Pokémon spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.

species.name: ludicolo
species.description: LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This Pokémon is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.

species.name: seedot
species.description: SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this Pokémon’s body becomes.

species.name: nuzleaf
species.description: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This Pokémon dislikes having its long nose pinched.

species.name: shiftry
species.description: SHIFTRY is a mysterious Pokémon that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.

species.name: taillow
species.description: TAILLOW courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy Pokémon will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.

species.name: swellow
species.description: SWELLOW flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This Pokémon dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW’s clawed feet, preventing escape.

species.name: wingull
species.description: WINGULL has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This Pokémon rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.

species.name: pelipper
species.description: PELIPPER is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon and eggs inside its massive bill. This Pokémon builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.

species.name: ralts
species.description: RALTS senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This Pokémon rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.

species.name: kirlia
species.description: It is said that a KIRLIA that is exposed to the positive emotions of its TRAINER grows beautiful. This Pokémon controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.

species.name: gardevoir
species.description: GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its TRAINER, this Pokémon is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.

species.name: surskit
species.description: From the tips of its feet, SURSKIT secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.

species.name: masquerain
species.description: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This Pokémon flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction - even sideways and backwards - as if it were a helicopter.

species.name: shroomish
species.description: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This Pokémon feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.

species.name: breloom
species.description: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This Pokémon’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.

species.name: slakoth
species.description: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This Pokémon’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.

species.name: vigoroth
species.description: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This Pokémon’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.

species.name: slaking
species.description: SLAKING spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this Pokémon reluctantly moves to another spot.

species.name: nincada
species.description: NINCADA lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This Pokémon absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.

species.name: ninjask
species.description: NINJASK moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this Pokémon was long believed to be invisible.

species.name: shedinja
species.description: SHEDINJA’s hard body doesn’t move - not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this Pokémon will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.

species.name: whismur
species.description: Normally, WHISMUR’s voice is very quiet - it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this Pokémon senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.

species.name: loudred
species.description: LOUDRED’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This Pokémon’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.

species.name: exploud
species.description: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this Pokémon violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.

species.name: makuhita
species.description: MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this Pokémon stores more energy in its body for evolving.

species.name: hariyama
species.description: HARIYAMA practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this Pokémon’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.

species.name: azurill
species.description: AZURILL spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these Pokémon managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.

species.name: nosepass
species.description: NOSEPASS’s magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these Pokémon meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.

species.name: skitty
species.description: SKITTY has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This Pokémon is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.

species.name: delcatty
species.description: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this Pokémon eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.

species.name: sableye
species.description: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these Pokémon are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.

species.name: mawile
species.description: MAWHILE’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, MAWHILE chomps it with its gaping jaws.

species.name: aron
species.description: This Pokémon has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.

species.name: lairon
species.description: LAIRON tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This Pokémon makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.

species.name: aggron
species.description: AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This Pokémon vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.

species.name: meditite
species.description: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this Pokémon always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.

species.name: medicham
species.description: It is said that through meditation, MEDICHAM heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokémon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.

species.name: electrike
species.description: ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its long body hair. This Pokémon stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.

species.name: manectric
species.description: MANECTRIC is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this Pokémon creates thunderclouds.

species.name: plusle
species.description: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this Pokémon shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.

species.name: minun
species.description: MINUN is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.

species.name: volbeat
species.description: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This Pokémon is attracted by the sweet aroma of ILLUMISE.

species.name: illumise
species.description: ILLUMISE attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT using a sweet fragrance. Once the VOLBEAT have gathered, this Pokémon leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.

species.name: roselia
species.description: ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this Pokémon brings serenity to living things.

species.name: gulpin
species.description: Virtually all of GULPIN’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This Pokémon’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.

species.name: swalot
species.description: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this Pokémon gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.

species.name: carvanha
species.description: CARVANHA’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this Pokémon.

species.name: sharpedo
species.description: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” SHARPEDO is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these Pokémon can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.

species.name: wailmer
species.description: WAILMER’s nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful Pokémon loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.

species.name: wailord
species.description: WAILORD is the largest of all identified Pokémon up to now. This giant Pokémon swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.

species.name: numel
species.description: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This Pokémon’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.

species.name: camerupt
species.description: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this Pokémon’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.

species.name: torkoal
species.description: TORKOAL digs through mountains in search of coal. If it finds some, it fills hollow spaces on its shell with the coal and burns it. If it is attacked, this Pokémon spouts thick black smoke to beat a retreat.

species.name: spoink
species.description: SPOINK bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this Pokémon cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it stops, its heart will stop.

species.name: grumpig
species.description: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this Pokémon uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.

species.name: spinda
species.description: All the SPINDA that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this Pokémon give it the appearance of dancing.

species.name: trapinch
species.description: TRAPINCH’s nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This Pokémon patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.

species.name: vibrava
species.description: To make prey faint, VIBRAVA generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This Pokémon’s ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.

species.name: flygon
species.description: FLYGON is nicknamed “the elemental spirit of the desert.” Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this Pokémon is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.

species.name: cacnea
species.description: CACNEA lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this Pokémon shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.

species.name: cacturne
species.description: During the daytime, CACTURNE remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This Pokémon becomes active at night when the temperature drops.

species.name: swablu
species.description: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This Pokémon is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.

species.name: altaria
species.description: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this Pokémon makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.

species.name: zangoose
species.description: Memories of battling its arch-rival SEVIPER are etched into every cell of ZANGOOSE’s body. This Pokémon adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.

species.name: seviper
species.description: SEVIPER shares a generations-long feud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This Pokémon attacks using its sword- edged tail.

species.name: lunatone
species.description: LUNATONE was discovered at a location where a meteorite fell. As a result, some people theorize that this Pokémon came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.

species.name: solrock
species.description: SOLROCK is a new species of Pokémon that is said to have fallen from space. It floats in air and moves silently. In battle, this Pokémon releases intensely bright light.

species.name: barboach
species.description: BARBOACH’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This Pokémon hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.

species.name: whiscash
species.description: WHISCASH is extremely territorial. Just one of these Pokémon will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.

species.name: corphish
species.description: CORPHISH were originally foreign Pokémon that were imported as pets. They eventually turned up in the wild. This Pokémon is very hardy and has greatly increased its population.

species.name: crawdaunt
species.description: CRAWDAUNT has an extremely violent nature that compels it to challenge other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in ponds inhabited by this Pokémon, making them desolate places.

species.name: baltoy
species.description: BALTOY moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this Pokémon living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.

species.name: claydol
species.description: CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This Pokémon moves about while levitating.

species.name: lileep
species.description: LILEEP became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient Pokémon attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.

species.name: cradily
species.description: CRADILY roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This Pokémon freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.

species.name: anorith
species.description: ANORITH was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive Pokémon once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.

species.name: armaldo
species.description: ARMALDO’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This Pokémon’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.

species.name: feebas
species.description: FEEBAS’s fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this Pokémon is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.

species.name: milotic
species.description: MILOTIC is said to be the most beautiful of all the Pokémon. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility to quell bitter feuding.

species.name: castform
species.description: CASTFORM’s appearance changes with the weather. This Pokémon gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.

species.name: kecleon
species.description: KECLEON is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception - this Pokémon can’t change the zigzag pattern on its belly.

species.name: shuppet
species.description: SHUPPET is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this Pokémon will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.

species.name: banette
species.description: BANETTE generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokémon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.

species.name: duskull
species.description: DUSKULL can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this Pokémon chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.

species.name: dusclops
species.description: DUSCLOPS’s body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This Pokémon will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.

species.name: tropius
species.description: The bunches of fruit around TROPIUS’s neck are very popular with children. This Pokémon loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.

species.name: chimecho
species.description: CHIMECHO makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this Pokémon becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.

species.name: absol
species.description: Every time ABSOL appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster Pokémon.

species.name: wynaut
species.description: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this Pokémon will be slapping the ground with its tail.

species.name: snorunt
species.description: SNORUNT live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this Pokémon steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.

species.name: glalie
species.description: GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This Pokémon has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.

species.name: spheal
species.description: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this Pokémon eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.

species.name: sealeo
species.description: SEALEO has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This Pokémon occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL on its nose.

species.name: walrein
species.description: WALREIN’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing ten tons with one blow. This Pokémon’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.

species.name: clamperl
species.description: CLAMPERL’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection - it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown CLAMPERL’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.

species.name: huntail
species.description: HUNTAIL’s presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This Pokémon’s eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.

species.name: gorebyss
species.description: GOREBYSS lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this Pokémon’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.

species.name: relicanth
species.description: RELICANTH is a Pokémon species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.

species.name: luvdisc
species.description: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped Pokémon earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.

species.name: bagon
species.description: BAGON has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this Pokémon hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.

species.name: shelgon
species.description: Inside SHELGON’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This Pokémon’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.

species.name: salamence
species.description: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this Pokémon’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.

species.name: beldum
species.description: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout BELDUM’s body. This Pokémon communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.

species.name: metang
species.description: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this Pokémon generates strong psychokinetic power.

species.name: metagross
species.description: METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This Pokémon can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.

species.name: regirock
species.description: REGIROCK was sealed away by people long ago. If this Pokémon’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.

species.name: regice
species.description: REGICE’s body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can’t be melted, even by fire. This Pokémon controls frigid air of minus 328 degrees F.

species.name: registeel
species.description: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this Pokémon eats.

species.name: latias
species.description: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokémon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.

species.name: latios
species.description: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokémon is intelligent and understands human speech.

species.name: kyogre
species.description: KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This Pokémon saved people who were suffering from droughts.

species.name: groudon
species.description: GROUDON has long been described in mythology as the Pokémon that raised lands and expanded continents. This Pokémon took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.

species.name: rayquaza
species.description: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, never descending to the ground. This Pokémon appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.

species.name: jirachi
species.description: A legend states that JIRACHI will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this Pokémon senses danger, it will fight without awakening.

species.name: deoxys
species.description: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon’s chest appears to be its brain.

species.name: turtwig
species.description: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

species.name: grotle
species.description: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

species.name: torterra
species.description: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

species.name: chimchar
species.description: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

species.name: monferno
species.description: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

species.name: infernape
species.description: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

species.name: piplup
species.description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

species.name: prinplup
species.description: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

species.name: empoleon
species.description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

species.name: starly
species.description: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

species.name: staravia
species.description: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

species.name: staraptor
species.description: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

species.name: bidoof
species.description: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

species.name: bibarel
species.description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

species.name: kricketot
species.description: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

species.name: kricketune
species.description: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

species.name: shinx
species.description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

species.name: luxio
species.description: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

species.name: luxray
species.description: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

species.name: budew
species.description: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

species.name: roserade
species.description: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

species.name: cranidos
species.description: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

species.name: rampardos
species.description: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

species.name: shieldon
species.description: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

species.name: bastiodon
species.description: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

species.name: burmy
species.description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

species.name: wormadam
species.description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

species.name: mothim
species.description: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.

species.name: combee
species.description: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.

species.name: vespiquen
species.description: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.

species.name: pachirisu
species.description: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

species.name: buizel
species.description: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

species.name: floatzel
species.description: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

species.name: cherubi
species.description: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

species.name: cherrim
species.description: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

species.name: shellos
species.description: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

species.name: gastrodon
species.description: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

species.name: ambipom
species.description: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

species.name: drifloon
species.description: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

species.name: drifblim
species.description: It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

species.name: buneary
species.description: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

species.name: lopunny
species.description: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

species.name: mismagius
species.description: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

species.name: honchkrow
species.description: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.

species.name: glameow
species.description: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

species.name: purugly
species.description: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.

species.name: chingling
species.description: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

species.name: stunky
species.description: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

species.name: skuntank
species.description: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

species.name: bronzor
species.description: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

species.name: bronzong
species.description: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

species.name: bonsly
species.description: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.

species.name: mime-jr
species.description: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

species.name: happiny
species.description: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

species.name: chatot
species.description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

species.name: spiritomb
species.description: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

species.name: gible
species.description: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

species.name: gabite
species.description: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.

species.name: garchomp
species.description: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

species.name: munchlax
species.description: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

species.name: riolu
species.description: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

species.name: lucario
species.description: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

species.name: hippopotas
species.description: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

species.name: hippowdon
species.description: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

species.name: skorupi
species.description: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

species.name: drapion
species.description: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

species.name: croagunk
species.description: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

species.name: toxicroak
species.description: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

species.name: carnivine
species.description: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

species.name: finneon
species.description: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

species.name: lumineon
species.description: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

species.name: mantyke
species.description: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

species.name: snover
species.description: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

species.name: abomasnow
species.description: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

species.name: weavile
species.description: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

species.name: magnezone
species.description: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

species.name: lickilicky
species.description: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

species.name: rhyperior
species.description: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.

species.name: tangrowth
species.description: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

species.name: electivire
species.description: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

species.name: magmortar
species.description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

species.name: togekiss
species.description: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.

species.name: yanmega
species.description: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

species.name: leafeon
species.description: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

species.name: glaceon
species.description: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

species.name: gliscor
species.description: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

species.name: mamoswine
species.description: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

species.name: porygon-z
species.description: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.

species.name: gallade
species.description: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

species.name: probopass
species.description: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

species.name: dusknoir
species.description: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

species.name: froslass
species.description: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

species.name: rotom
species.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

species.name: uxie
species.description: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

species.name: mesprit
species.description: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

species.name: azelf
species.description: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

species.name: dialga
species.description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

species.name: palkia
species.description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

species.name: heatran
species.description: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

species.name: regigigas
species.description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

species.name: giratina
species.description: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

species.name: cresselia
species.description: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

species.name: phione
species.description: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

species.name: manaphy
species.description: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

species.name: darkrai
species.description: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
